game_concept: A puzzle set in Shadow Cave – Collapsed Passage, a half-collapsed passage: the lantern keeper must handle glow-eyed lurkers while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Digit Mill: Peel digits off a number with while n > 0 using // and %.
theme: Shadow Cave – Collapsed Passage: a half-collapsed passage
core_gameplay_loop: In Collapsed Passage, repeat each round: Peel digits off a number with while n > 0 using // and %. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the digits value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the lantern post using at most 16 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
win_condition: The lantern post reached with actions_used <= 16.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 16 before the lantern post is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 4 – Control Flow: While Loops | Level 4 (applied tier): Digit Mill
assets_style: dark pixel-art cavern: torchlit stone, mossy rock, deep shadows, glowing crystals; flat Kenney-style sprites; echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Digit Mill' (Week 4 slot 13), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Collapsed Passage'. tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how digits changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against glow-eyed lurkers in Collapsed Passage.
